name: creative-craft
description: Create distinctive campaign concepts, copy, art direction, image and video briefs, critiques, and traceable creative production when needed.

interface.shortDescription: High-quality creative work without process overhead
interface.longDescription: Creative Craft turns incomplete briefs, references, and existing assets into distinctive concepts, commercial copy, art direction, production-ready image or video briefs, and evidence-aware critiques. It answers bounded requests directly and adds traceable project artifacts only for campaigns that need durable execution, approvals, provenance, or delivery verification.
defaultPrompt: Turn this brief into distinct creative routes and recommend one.
Write production-ready launch copy with a clear job for each line.
Create an art direction and executable image or video production brief.
Critique these creative assets and propose the smallest high-value revision.
